constraints.autonomy: 100% autonomous incident handling; no human page/escalation path
constraints.deployment_authority: OpenTofu primary with Makefile/bootstrap/install entrypoints and ops-managed day-2 convergence
forbidden: interactive host login as troubleshooting path
provider console mutation outside audited break-glass
ad-hoc branch-protection mutation outside pre-authorized rollback policy
normal_recovery_surfaces: autonomous hotfix PR with regression gate

gap_analysis.finding: post_deploy_observability named only coarse lanes and did not bind breaches to per-error-class triage, rollback, evidence, and learn-loop actions
gap_analysis.patch: add pipeline.slo_breach_playbooks with decision tree, error classes, telemetry signals, rollback triggers, and evidence contract

gap_analysis.finding: ADR-0114 emergency rewind included a human signing key plus temporary force-push bypass; that conflicts with autonomous_foundry and deployment-ops authority if treated as default
gap_analysis.patch: constrain emergency rewind to a pre-authorized autonomous break-glass policy; otherwise canonical rollback PR or Argo rollback is mandatory

gap_analysis.finding: incident_response root causes were enumerated but not connected to first-hour launch checks, incident JSON keys, or prevention evidence
gap_analysis.patch: require EVT-CANARY-VERDICT, EVT-ROLLBACK-EXECUTED, EVT-INCIDENT-CLASSIFIED, and EVT-LEARN-LOOP-CLOSED rows plus regression/fixup artifacts before promotion resumes

decision_tree.when: security, data-integrity, tenant isolation, or audit-chain freshness is breached
actions: freeze unsafe writes through ops policy when required

decision_tree.when: canary threshold breach is inside the 60 second ADR-0114 grace window
canary threshold still breaches after grace window
actions: Argo rollback exposed cells to previous revision
route code to hotfix PR or infra/config to OpenTofu/ops convergence

decision_tree.when: yellow threshold only and max observation window is not exhausted
actions: collect enough evidence for root-cause confidence

decision_tree.when: observation reaches 3600 seconds without clean promotion or known class
actions: hold rolled-back or current safe state

decision_tree.when: clean window reaches 900 seconds with no anomaly

signals: queue wait or dependency latency spike
playbooks.rollback_trigger: threshold still breached after 60 second grace or p95 exceeds launch rollback threshold
recovery: Argo rollback first if user impact
OpenTofu/ops capacity convergence only for capacity root cause
hotfix PR with performance regression test for code root cause
playbooks.learn_loop: add benchmark or canary signal lane when the missed latency class is repeatable

playbooks.rollback_trigger: error threshold still breached after grace or any critical path hard failure
recovery: Argo rollback
canonical rollback PR if merge is causative
autonomous hotfix PR with prove-it regression test
playbooks.learn_loop: promote recurring error signature to deterministic pre-merge or canary fitness lane

playbooks.rollback_trigger: saturation causes latency/error SLO breach or unsafe backpressure
triage: separate workload regression from capacity ceiling
recovery: rollback if new code increases resource demand unexpectedly
otherwise converge capacity by OpenTofu/ops plan/apply
emit capacity-event for cloud-capacity-kernel
playbooks.learn_loop: update capacity model and admission budget before promotion resumes

playbooks.rollback_trigger: any security posture regression; no hold-only mode
triage: map denied identities to release delta
recovery: quarantine bad digest
rollback exposed cells
converge policy via ops/OpenTofu or gitops PR
playbooks.learn_loop: add security sentinel or policy regression lane for the breached invariant

playbooks.rollback_trigger: any governance/provenance loss on production path
recovery: rollback/quarantine before analysis
repair emitter via hotfix PR
backfill only from signed evidence bundles
playbooks.learn_loop: add event-shape regression and freshness sentinel to score_cards or post-deploy lanes

playbooks.rollback_trigger: any integrity or tenant isolation breach
triage: verify write idempotency and migration ordering
recovery: rollback/quarantine
freeze unsafe writes through ops policy when needed
canonical repair PR with reversible migration proof
playbooks.learn_loop: add tenant/integrity sentinel and migration prove-it regression

playbooks.rollback_trigger: dependency change causes latency, error, security, or integrity SLO breach
recovery: rollback image first
pin/replace dependency via autonomous PR
amend source-driven evidence
playbooks.learn_loop: promote dependency sentinel if recurrence or high blast radius

playbooks.rollback_trigger: drift causes service impact or policy breach
triage: diff desired git state against live state
recovery: Argo selfHeal for gitops state
OpenTofu/ops convergence for infra state
rollback only if drift was introduced by current changeset
playbooks.learn_loop: add drift detector lane for repeated mismatch class

signals: quorum cannot classify into known classes
playbooks.rollback_trigger: any unknown class with user impact, safety risk, or governance uncertainty
recovery: no promotion until a spec amendment, regression gate, and root-cause class exist
conservative default if quorum does not converge
playbooks.learn_loop: emit ADR + lane candidate + regression test before resuming promotion

promotion_resume_requires: incident closed or service held in conservative safe state
OpenTofu/ops convergence evidence for infra/config/capacity fixes
